tools.name: reconcile_bank_to_books
tools.description: Use this when the user attaches a bank export or statement AND their books (cash account register or general ledger export from accounting software or a spreadsheet) and wants a bank reconciliation: "reconcile my bank statement", "reconcile bank statement against my books", "list what doesn't match"

tools.name: explain_reconciliation_difference
tools.description: Use this when the user attaches the bank file and the books file, gives the bank statement ending balance and the book balance, and asks why the bank reconciliation does not balance: "why is my bank reconciliation off", "reconciliation difference", "find the difference between bank and books". Runs

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: reconcile_bank_to_books · Private data: reconcile_bank_to_books, explain_reconciliation_difference · Public sink: reconcile_bank_to_books.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: reconcile_bank_to_books · Private data: reconcile_bank_to_books, explain_reconciliation_difference · Public sink: reconcile_bank_to_books

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
